name: file-media
description: Inspect binary media files: image mime + pixel dimensions (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP header parsing, no deps), PDF metadata and page text via pdftotext, optional base64 embedding for vision pipelines.
use_when: inspecting an image or extracting text/metadata from a PDF

args.name: --base64
args.description: Embed the file as base64 in the JSON result.

args.name: --pages
args.description: PDF page range to extract, e.g. '1-5'.

stdout: JSON object: {path, mime, size_bytes, width?, height?, text?, base64?}.
